terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A one-piece moulding: nothing opens, turns or swings, nothing attaches, so one root pivot and zero sockets. Placed by the dozen at every street table, so the single draw call is the design constraint. Every street food table, temple fair and shophouse front; stacked in towers when not in use. Red polypropylene worn pale on the seat, dusty at the feet.

reasoning: ONE dished seat lathe with a raised rim (closed underneath), ONE worn-disc lathe 2 mm proud of the seat floor, four tapered wedge legs (trapezoids extruded 0.04 m and yawed to the diagonals) and four lugs at the rim: one merge on one material -- the ONE draw call the small class allows.
One material: red plastic as a vertex colour on white, the worn seat top a paler vertex colour, scratches as a light streak canvas.
No repetition system at one draw call: four legs are four extrusions in the merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the round dished seat with its four lugs and legs that taper and splay; straight posts read as a bar stool, so the legs are wedges leaning outward.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.32 x 0.43 x 0.32 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=800 triangles, <=1 draw calls, <=1 materials, <=2 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

The plate is a from-above view on a white matte and the proxy normalises to w:h:d 1:0.598:1.001 -- its height is foreshortened -- so only its plan is used: seat disc 0.94 W, legs at the four lugs between the axes, 0.03-0.10 W wide from rim to foot. roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/red.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.840. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-red (0.84) at #964f4e (a leg in shade on a WHITE matte) and region-rim at #bf5149; carried at #b03a2e as a vertex colour on a WHITE material, the worn seat disc at #c8837a off region-seat #c4776d.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px light streak canvas after construction.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the small class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

materials.note: plastic only: 1 of 1; the worn top is a vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 576 of 800: two 24-segment lathes, four wedge extrusions, four boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: A lathe for the dished seat, a thin lathe for the worn disc, extruded trapezoids for the legs, boxes for the lugs.
No InstancedMesh at one draw call. In a scene the HOST instances the stool.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px streak canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.
